intervals.quote: Last night, the beams were dumped for the final time from the PEP-II rings and the BaBar experiment took its last data.

name: BaBar Collaboration
notes: Institution-level membership rows and leadership are out of scope for this wave (person records and rosters are owned by other workstreams).
Derived field collaboration.experiment_ids is deliberately not written (v0.2 A1).

CERN Courier dates the organizing "Detector Collaboration for the PEP-II asymmetric electron-positron collider"'s inaugural meeting to the end of 1993, with the name "BaBar" adopted by May 1994; this predates the INSPIRE date_proposed field (1994-06) used for `formation` below. Both are recorded; `formation` uses the INSPIRE value as the more precisely dated of the two, with this note flagging the earlier informal start.

summary.plain: More than 500 scientists, engineers and graduate students from about 10 countries who built and ran the BaBar particle detector at SLAC from 1999 to 2008 to study why matter and antimatter behave differently.
summary.technical: International collaboration operating the BaBar detector at the SLAC PEP-II B-factory; per the INSPIRE experiment record, more than 500 scientists, engineers and graduate students from 10 countries.
